new_value: Fixed the dataclasses.replace desync: LocalFact.__post_init__ now raises LocalFactError when both wire bstrs are present and LocalFactClaims.from_cbor(payload_bytes) != claims (decoded-equality, encoding-agnostic per the docstring contract). Also fixed 2 defects caught by delegated codereview pass 1: (1) channel normalized to tuple via object.__setattr__ in LocalFactClaims.__post_init__ (list-channel issuance false-rejected the guard); (2) added explicit 'wire bstrs must be bytes' isinstance check (TypeError leak on non-bytes). Added 4 tests: desync-rejected, matching-bstrs-accepted, list-channel-issue-accepted, non-bytes-bstr-rejected. Verified: 34 local_facts tests pass, 377 gateway suite pass, behavioral probe of all 3 fixes PASS, desync test non-vacuous (fails pre-fix). Codereview: pass1 (kimi-k3) found the 2 defects -> fixed; re-review pass2 (security) + pass3 (edge) via subagents: PASS + PASS (edge pass confirmed empty-channel/list-subclass/pickle-hash/copy all sound, encoding-agnosticism real, no construction path regresses). One cosmetic stale comment ('line 192') also corrected.
